name: comp-318

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the FAQ title with the sticky Cancel and Okay footer still in view.

tagline: Tall FAQ dialog keeps its Cancel and Okay buttons pinned while text scrolls.
summary: A trigger opens a narrow, tall dialog full of FAQ paragraphs. The body scrolls on its own while an outlined Cancel and a white Okay stay fixed in a bordered footer.
appearance: Closed, a single outlined button. Open, a tall dark rounded dialog: a left-aligned FAQ heading, dense small paragraphs under bold subheads, and a divider over a footer with outlined Cancel and white Okay at the right.
behaviour: The trigger opens the dialog over a dimmed page. Scrolling moves only the body text while the footer stays put; Cancel, Okay, Escape or an outside click closes it.
demo_content: FAQ sections on account management, password reset, pricing, support, data protection, compatibility and subscription.
search_phrases: long content modal with sticky footer
faq popup with cancel and okay
popup for long text with scrolling
use_when: A dialog holds long copy but its action buttons must stay reachable while the body scrolls.
avoid_when: The body is a wall of placeholder FAQ text, so it needs replacing before it can ship.
customise: Title, FAQ copy and footer labels are written in the file; nothing is exposed as props.
weight_why: One dialog with native scrolling and no animation beyond its opening fade.

a11y.note: The dialog primitive traps focus and Escape closes it, but the file itself has no reduced-motion handling.

issues: Ten blocks of placeholder FAQ copy fill the body and must be replaced.
polish_why: Clean pinned footer and tidy spacing, but the shipped content is generic filler.
